subject.title: fix(codex): cap sandbox file copy reads

question: Should OpenClaw accept the compatibility change that Codex sandbox `fs/copy` rejects files above the existing 512 MiB read cap, or require a streaming copy contract instead?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct, but it deliberately changes behavior for existing oversized copy operations, which is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept the cap
options.body: Land this PR so all full-buffer Codex sandbox file reads, including copy leaves, share the existing 512 MiB guard.

options.title: Require streaming copy
options.body: Hold this PR and ask for a bridge/protocol design that preserves oversized copy support without buffering the source file.

recommendation.title: Accept the cap
recommendation.body: Land this PR so all full-buffer Codex sandbox file reads, including copy leaves, share the existing 512 MiB guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent nearby Codex sandbox hardening/refactor history and merge ownership make this the best available compatibility decision owner.
